newsitem.title: PERU: Peru 56-day CDs draw 12.85 pct avg rate at sale.
newsitem.headline: Peru 56-day CDs draw 12.85 pct avg rate at sale.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru said Thursday it accepted bids for 56-day Certificates of Deposit (CDs) worth 60 million soles at an effective average annual rate of 12.85 percent during a bank auction.
The CDs have a July 11 starting date.
The accepted bids also had a minimum rate of 11.00 percent and a maximum rate of 13.00 percent, the bank said.
At the last CD auction Wednesday, 28-day CDs drew an average rate of 10.50 percent.
At Thursday's auction, the bank said it received bids on the CDs totalling 129.0 million soles. The bank had offered 60 million soles worth of CDs.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
